auditor.opinion: Unqualified - The standalone financial statements give a true and fair view in conformity with Ind AS and other accounting principles generally accepted in India
key_audit_matters: Valuation and Sale of Equity Shares Classified as FVTOCI under Ind AS 109 - The Company designated its investment in equity shares of INOR Medical under FVTOCI option. During the year, the Company sold 48,000 equity shares at ₹371.91 per share. The cumulative gain recognized in OCI and not routed through profit or loss. This area is considered a key audit matter due to the significance of the transaction, the judgment involved in determining fair value, and compliance with accounting standards relating to classification, measurement, and sale of equity instruments.

The Company sold its investment comprising 48,000 Equity Shares of INOR Medical Products Limited on 25 February 2026 at a price of ₹ 371.91 per share for an aggregate consideration of ₹ 178.52 Lakhs.

During the year, a deferred tax asset amounting to ₹0.15 lakh arose on account of remeasurement losses/(gains) relating to defined benefit obligations recognised through Other Comprehensive Income. However, considering the uncertainty regarding future taxable profits and in order to maintain consistency with the overall assessment of recoverability of deferred tax assets, the corresponding deferred tax asset has been recognised on the face of the financials, and negated by an equal and corresponding entry in the other expense. Consequently, the net deferred tax asset recognised in the financial statements as at the reporting date is Nil.
